recipes.title: Halal-cart chicken & rice
recipes.subtitle: Broth rice · punchy garlic sauce · crisp roasted side
recipes.description: Spiced chicken over savoury broth rice, with finely chopped salad, garlic-herb yogurt sauce and crisp roasted chickpeas and carrots.

items: 150 g halal chicken breast, raw, bite-sized chunks
80 ml low-sodium halal chicken broth, no alcohol; follow rice packet ratio
0.2 g fine salt for rice; omit if broth already tastes seasoned
3 g garlic, crushed to a paste
10–15 ml cold water; add only enough to pour

ingredients.group: Crisp chickpeas & browned carrots — small side
items: 30 g cooked chickpeas, drained, no added salt
3 g lemon juice, for carrots after roasting
40 g iceberg lettuce, finely shredded and shortened

steps: Heat oven to 220°C / 200°C fan. Dry chickpeas very well; leave on a towel while prepping. Finely dice tomato and carrot. Finely shred and shorten lettuce. Mince garlic and parsley. On a separate board, cut chicken into small chunks. Mix with its oil, lemon, garlic, spices and chicken salt. Refrigerate chicken for 20–30 minutes while the side roasts.

Toss chickpeas and carrots with their oil and side salt. Spread in separate areas on a metal tray. Roast chickpeas for 25–30 minutes; shake halfway. Carrots need about 20–25 minutes; remove when browned. For the final 5 minutes, toss both with the side cumin, smoked paprika and garlic powder. Return to oven. Finish carrots with lemon and parsley. Add crisp chickpeas just before serving; keep uncovered.

Rinse rice and drain well. Heat rice oil over medium-low. Stir in rice, cumin and turmeric for 1 minute. Add broth; use the packet liquid ratio. Taste the broth; add only the listed rice salt if needed. Bring to a boil. Cover; simmer on low for 10–12 minutes. Rest off heat, covered, for 10 minutes. Fluff.

Crush sauce garlic with its salt. Whisk in yogurt, oil, lemon, vinegar, sugar, cumin, chilli and parsley. Add cold water a little at a time, only until pourable. Do not use extra water to increase the volume. Chill for 15 minutes. Stir and taste: garlicky, bright and savoury, with a little heat.

Heat a non-stick pan over medium-high. Add chicken in one uncrowded layer. Leave for 2–3 minutes to brown. Turn; cook for another 4–6 minutes. Lower heat if spices scorch. Check the thickest chicken reaches 74°C. Rest for 3 minutes; keep the pan juices.

Taste one bite of chicken, rice, salad and sauce together before plating. Plate rice with chicken and its juices. Add the fresh tomato and lettuce beside them. Drizzle some sauce; serve the rest alongside. Serve the small crisp side separately.

tl.description: Manok na may spices sa kaning niluto sa broth, kasama ang pinong salad, garlic-herb yogurt sauce at malutong na roasted chickpeas at carrots.

items: 150 g halal chicken breast, hilaw, maliliit na chunks
0.6 g pinong asin para sa manok
80 ml low-sodium halal chicken broth, walang alcohol; sundin ang ratio sa pakete ng bigas
0.2 g pinong asin para sa kanin; huwag idagdag kung sapat na ang alat ng sabaw
0.3 g pinong asin para sa sarsa
10–15 ml malamig na tubig; sapat lamang para maibuhos

ingredients.group: Crispy chickpeas at browned carrots — maliit na side
items: 30 g lutong chickpeas, pinatulo, walang dagdag na asin
0.2 g pinong asin para sa side
3 g lemon juice, para sa carrot matapos i-roast
40 g iceberg lettuce, pinong shredded at pinaikli

steps: Painitin ang oven sa 220°C / 200°C fan. Patuyuing mabuti ang chickpeas; ilagay sa tuwalya habang naghahanda. Pinong i-dice ang kamatis at carrot. Pinong i-shred at paikliin ang lettuce. Tadtarin ang bawang at parsley. Sa hiwalay na sangkalan, hiwain ang manok sa maliliit na chunks. Ihalo ang nakalaang mantika, lemon, bawang, spices at asin para sa manok. Ilagay ang manok sa refrigerator nang 20–30 minuto habang nagro-roast ang side.

Ihalo ang chickpeas at carrot sa nakalaang mantika at asin. Ikalat sa magkahiwalay na bahagi ng metal tray. I-roast ang chickpeas nang 25–30 minuto; alugin sa kalagitnaan. Mga 20–25 minuto ang carrot; alisin kapag browned na. Sa huling 5 minuto, ihalo ang nakalaang cumin, smoked paprika at garlic powder. Ibalik sa oven. Lagyan ng lemon at parsley ang carrot. Idagdag ang crispy chickpeas bago ihain; huwag takpan.

Hugasan at patuluing mabuti ang bigas. Painitin ang mantika para sa kanin sa katamtaman hanggang mahinang apoy. Igisa ang bigas, cumin at turmeric nang 1 minuto. Idagdag ang sabaw; sundin ang ratio sa pakete. Tikman ang sabaw; idagdag lamang ang nakalaang asin kung kailangan. Pakuluan. Takpan; lutuin sa mahinang apoy nang 10–12 minuto. Ipahinga nang may takip, walang apoy, nang 10 minuto. Buhaghagin.

Durugin ang bawang kasama ang asin para sa sarsa. Ihalo ang yogurt, mantika, lemon, suka, asukal, cumin, chilli at parsley. Unti-unting lagyan ng malamig na tubig hanggang maibuhos. Huwag dagdagan ng tubig para lang dumami. Palamigin nang 15 minuto. Haluin at tikman: malasa ang bawang, may asim at kaunting anghang.

Painitin ang non-stick pan sa katamtaman hanggang malakas na apoy. Ilagay ang manok sa isang layer na hindi siksikan. Hayaang mag-brown nang 2–3 minuto. Baligtarin; lutuin pa nang 4–6 minuto. Hinaan kung nasusunog ang spices. Tiyaking 74°C ang pinakamakapal na manok. Ipahinga nang 3 minuto; itabi ang katas sa kawali.

Tikman nang sabay ang kaunting manok, kanin, salad at sarsa bago ihain. Ihain ang kanin kasama ang manok at katas nito. Ilagay sa tabi ang sariwang kamatis at lettuce. Lagyan ng kaunting sarsa; ihain ang natira sa tabi. Ihiwalay ang maliit na crispy side.

recipes.title: Saucy chicken curry & rice
recipes.subtitle: Tomato-ginger gravy · green beans in the curry
recipes.description: Chicken and green beans in a fragrant tomato-ginger curry, finished with yogurt and lemon. Basmati rice alongside.

items: 150 g halal chicken breast, raw, skinless
112.5 g green beans, trimmed and cut short
150 ml water, plus a splash if needed
scant ¼ tsp mild chilli powder
0.75 g salt TOTAL, divided across curry and rice

steps: Wash the vegetables. Finely dice onion and tomato. Trim and cut green beans short. Mince ginger and garlic. Cut chicken into bite-sized chunks on a separate board.
Rinse rice. Add its water and a little of the salt. Bring to a boil; cover and simmer on low for 10–12 minutes. Rest covered, off the heat, for 10 minutes. Follow packet ratios if different.

Heat oil over medium. Soften onion for 7–8 minutes. Add ginger and garlic; stir for 1 minute. Add cumin, coriander, turmeric and chilli; stir for 30 seconds. Add tomato and remaining salt. Cook 6–8 minutes until soft.

Add chicken, beans and the gravy water. Stir. Partly cover; simmer gently for 12–15 minutes. Check chicken reaches 74°C and beans are tender. Add a splash of water if needed: gravy should pour easily.
Turn heat off. Whisk a spoonful of warm gravy into the yogurt. Stir yogurt into the curry with garam masala and lemon. Do not boil. Add coriander. Serve all the curry and sauce with rice alongside.

tl.description: Manok at green beans sa mabangong tomato-ginger curry, tinapos sa yogurt at lemon. May basmati rice sa tabi.

items: 150 g halal chicken breast, hilaw at walang balat
112.5 g green beans, tinanggalan ng dulo at hiniwa nang maikli
150 ml tubig, dagdagan nang kaunti kung kailangan
kulang na ¼ tsp mild chilli powder
0.75 g asin SA KABUUAN, paghatiin sa curry at kanin
40 g basmati rice, timbang bago lutuin
90 ml tubig, o ratio sa pakete

steps: Hugasan ang gulay. Pinong i-dice ang sibuyas at kamatis. Putulin ang dulo at hiwain nang maikli ang green beans. Tadtarin ang luya at bawang. Hiwain ang manok sa maliliit na chunks sa hiwalay na sangkalan.

Hugasan ang bigas. Idagdag ang tubig nito at kaunting asin. Pakuluan; takpan at lutuin sa mahinang apoy nang 10–12 minuto. Ipahinga nang may takip, walang apoy, nang 10 minuto. Sundin ang ratio sa pakete kung iba.

Painitin ang mantika sa katamtamang apoy. Palambutin ang sibuyas nang 7–8 minuto. Idagdag ang luya at bawang; haluin nang 1 minuto. Idagdag ang cumin, coriander, turmeric at chilli; haluin nang 30 segundo. Idagdag ang kamatis at natitirang asin. Lutuin nang 6–8 minuto hanggang lumambot.

Idagdag ang manok, green beans at tubig para sa gravy. Haluin. Bahagyang takpan; pakuluin nang marahan nang 12–15 minuto. Tiyaking 74°C ang manok at malambot ang green beans. Dagdagan ng kaunting tubig kung kailangan: dapat madaling ibuhos ang gravy.

Patayin ang apoy. Haluin ang isang kutsarang mainit na gravy sa yogurt. Ihalo ang yogurt sa curry kasama ang garam masala at lemon. Huwag pakuluan. Idagdag ang coriander. Ihain ang buong curry at sarsa, katabi ang kanin.

recipes.title: Tender kofta & potatoes
recipes.subtitle: Tomato-onion sauce · fresh chopped salad
recipes.description: Soft, gently mixed beef kofta with golden potatoes and plenty of tomato-onion sauce. A fresh chopped salad on the side.

items: 180 g halal lean beef mince, 5% fat, raw
30 g grated onion, weighed after gently squeezing
250 g potato, small chunks, skin on
4 g olive oil for the pan
1 g salt TOTAL, divided across kofta, potatoes and sauce
60 g iceberg lettuce, finely shredded and cut short

steps: Heat oven to 210°C / 190°C fan. Wash vegetables. Cut potatoes small. Finely dice tomatoes and sauce onion. Finely shred and shorten lettuce. Mince garlic and parsley. Soak oats in their water for 5 minutes. Grate and gently squeeze kofta onion.
Toss potatoes with their oil, paprika and some salt. Spread on a lined tray. Roast 30–35 minutes, turning halfway. Cook until golden and tender.

Combine beef, soaked oats, squeezed onion, parsley, garlic and spices. Add a little of the salt. Fold just until combined; do not knead. Shape into five loose, short ovals per serving. Do not squeeze tight.

Heat pan oil over medium-high. Brown kofta for 2 minutes per side; lift out. Lower heat. Soften sauce onion for 5 minutes; add garlic for 30 seconds. Add sauce tomato and remaining salt. Cook 5 minutes, then add water.
Return kofta to sauce. Cover and simmer gently for 8–10 minutes. Check the centre of the kofta reaches 71°C. Loosen sauce with a splash of water if needed.
Dress salad tomato and lettuce with lemon. Serve kofta with all the sauce, potatoes alongside and salad in its own bowl.

tl.description: Malambot na beef kofta, marahang hinalo, may golden na patatas at maraming tomato-onion sauce. May sariwang chopped salad sa tabi.

items: 180 g halal lean beef mince, 5% fat, hilaw
30 g gadgad na sibuyas, timbang matapos pigain nang marahan
250 g patatas, maliliit na chunks, may balat
4 g olive oil para sa patatas
4 g olive oil para sa kawali
1 g asin SA KABUUAN, paghatiin sa kofta, patatas at sarsa
60 g iceberg lettuce, pinong shredded at pinaikli

steps: Painitin ang oven sa 210°C / 190°C fan. Hugasan ang gulay. Hiwain nang maliit ang patatas. Pinong i-dice ang kamatis at sibuyas para sa sarsa. Pinong i-shred at paikliin ang lettuce. Tadtarin ang bawang at parsley. Ibabad ang oats sa tubig nito nang 5 minuto. Gadgarin at marahang pigain ang sibuyas para sa kofta.
Ihalo ang patatas sa mantika nito, paprika at kaunting asin. Ikalat sa tray na may liner. I-roast nang 30–35 minuto; baligtarin sa kalagitnaan. Lutuin hanggang golden at malambot.

Pagsamahin ang beef, binabad na oats, pinigang sibuyas, parsley, bawang at spices. Lagyan ng kaunting asin. Marahang ihalo hanggang magsama; huwag masahin. Hubugin sa limang maikling oval bawat serving. Huwag siksikin.

Painitin ang mantika sa katamtaman hanggang malakas na apoy. I-brown ang kofta nang 2 minuto bawat panig; iahon. Hinaan ang apoy. Palambutin ang sibuyas nang 5 minuto; idagdag ang bawang nang 30 segundo. Idagdag ang kamatis para sa sarsa at natitirang asin. Lutuin nang 5 minuto, saka idagdag ang tubig.
Ibalik ang kofta sa sarsa. Takpan at pakuluin nang marahan nang 8–10 minuto. Tiyaking 71°C ang gitna ng kofta. Dagdagan ng kaunting tubig kung kailangan para lumabnaw ang sarsa.

recipes.description: Glossy basil pesto pasta with golden chicken, seared courgette, spinach and sun-dried tomato strips. Fresh diced tomato finishes the bowl.

items: 180 g halal chicken breast, raw, skinless
55 g regular fusilli pasta, dry weight
3 g olive oil for the pan
1 g salt TOTAL, divided across chicken, vegetables and pesto
25 g sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, drained, sliced into short strips
10 g parmesan-style hard cheese, halal-certified or microbial/vegetarian rennet

steps: Wash vegetables. Finely dice tomato; cut courgette into small half-moons. Drain the sun-dried tomatoes; slice into short strips. Grate cheese. Peel garlic. Pick basil leaves. Cut chicken into bite-sized chunks on a separate board.

Toast almonds in a dry pan over medium-low for 3–4 minutes; cool. Finely blend almonds, basil, garlic, half the cheese, lemon, pesto oil and a little salt. Add a splash of water if needed to blend. Set aside.
Boil pasta in unsalted water until just tender, following packet timing. Reserve the listed pasta water before draining.

Season chicken with pepper and some salt. Heat pan oil over medium-high. Sear chicken for 2–3 minutes; turn and cook another 5–7 minutes, to 74°C. Lift chicken out. Pat courgette dry; sear in one layer for 4–5 minutes, turning once. Add spinach; wilt for 1 minute.

Turn heat off. Add pasta, chicken, sun-dried tomatoes and all the pesto. Toss with pasta water a splash at a time until loose and glossy. Keep the sauce loose and glossy; do not boil the pesto. Taste before adding any remaining measured salt.
Spoon into a warm bowl. Top with all the fresh tomato and remaining cheese. Serve immediately, while the sauce is glossy.

tl.description: Glossy basil pesto pasta na may golden na manok, seared courgette, spinach at sun-dried tomato strips. May sariwang diced na kamatis sa ibabaw.

items: 180 g halal chicken breast, hilaw at walang balat
55 g regular fusilli pasta, timbang bago lutuin
3 g olive oil para sa kawali
1 g asin SA KABUUAN, paghatiin sa manok, gulay at pesto
25 g sun-dried tomatoes na nasa mantika, pinatulo, hiniwa sa maiikling strips
10 g parmesan-style hard cheese, halal-certified o microbial/vegetarian rennet
3 g olive oil para sa pesto

steps: Hugasan ang gulay. Pinong i-dice ang kamatis; hiwain ang courgette sa maliliit na half-moon. Patuluin ang sun-dried tomatoes; hiwain sa maiikling strips. Gadgarin ang keso. Balatan ang bawang. Pitasin ang dahon ng basil. Hiwain ang manok sa maliliit na chunks sa hiwalay na sangkalan.

I-toast ang almonds sa tuyong kawali sa katamtaman hanggang mahinang apoy nang 3–4 minuto; palamigin. Pinong i-blend ang almonds, basil, bawang, kalahati ng keso, lemon, mantika para sa pesto at kaunting asin. Dagdagan ng kaunting tubig kung kailangan sa pag-blend. Itabi.
Pakuluan ang pasta sa tubig na walang asin hanggang lumambot, ayon sa oras sa pakete. Itabi ang nakalistang dami ng tubig ng pasta bago salain.

Timplahan ang manok ng pepper at kaunting asin. Painitin ang mantika sa katamtaman hanggang malakas na apoy. I-sear ang manok nang 2–3 minuto; baligtarin at lutuin pa nang 5–7 minuto, hanggang 74°C. Patayin ang apoy. Idagdag ang pasta, manok, sun-dried tomatoes at lahat ng pesto. Dagdagan ng pasta water nang paunti-unti hanggang malabnaw at glossy. Panatilihing malabnaw at glossy ang sarsa; huwag pakuluan ang pesto. Tikman bago idagdag ang natitirang nakasukat na asin.
Ilagay sa mainit na mangkok. Ilagay sa ibabaw ang lahat ng sariwang kamatis at natitirang keso. Ihain agad habang glossy pa ang sarsa.

recipes.title: Ajiaco chicken & potato soup
recipes.subtitle: Corn & guascas · rice, lettuce and sour cream alongside
recipes.description: A brothy, comforting take on ajiaco: chicken, soft potato and corn. Rice, finely shredded lettuce and sour cream arrive separately, ready to mix in your way.

items: 180 g halal chicken breast, raw, skinless
100 g floury potato, peeled and thinly sliced
100 g yellow potato or papa criolla, peeled, small chunks
80 g sweetcorn kernels, edible weight; use corn-on-cob rounds yielding this amount
500 ml low-sodium halal chicken stock, no alcohol
0.5 g salt TOTAL, use only as needed after tasting stock
60 g iceberg lettuce, finely shredded and cut short

steps: Wash vegetables. Mince onion, celery and garlic very finely. Peel potatoes: thinly slice floury potato; cut yellow potato into small chunks. Use short corn-on-cob rounds; ask the grocer to cut them if needed. Finely shred and shorten lettuce; keep chilled.
Heat oil over medium-low. Add onion and celery. Cook 8–10 minutes until very soft; add a splash of water if needed. Add garlic; stir for 1 minute.

Add stock, chicken, corn, both potatoes, guascas and pepper. Bring to a gentle simmer; partly cover. Cook for 18–22 minutes. Remove chicken once its centre reaches 74°C. Rest on a clean plate. Simmer soup another 10–15 minutes, until corn and potatoes are tender.

While soup simmers, rinse rice and add its water to a small lidded pan. Bring to a boil; cover and simmer on low for 10–12 minutes. Rest covered, off the heat, for 10 minutes. Follow packet ratios if different.

Shred chicken into short pieces and return it to the soup. Mash a few soft potato slices against the pot; leave some chunks. Add water if needed to keep it brothy. Heat through. Taste before adding any of the measured salt.
Ladle all the soup into a roomy bowl. Serve rice, lettuce and sour cream in three separate bowls. Mix them into the soup at the table, as you like.

25 g puting bigas, timbang bago lutuin
60 ml tubig, o ratio sa pakete
60 g iceberg lettuce, pinong shredded at pinaikli

steps: Hugasan ang gulay. Napakapinong tadtarin ang sibuyas, celery at bawang. Balatan ang patatas: manipis na hiwa sa floury potato; maliliit na chunks sa yellow potato. Painitin ang mantika sa katamtaman hanggang mahinang apoy. Idagdag ang sibuyas at celery. Lutuin nang 8–10 minuto hanggang napakalambot; dagdagan ng kaunting tubig kung kailangan. Idagdag ang bawang; haluin nang 1 minuto.

Ipahinga sa malinis na plato. Pakuluin pa nang marahan ang sopas nang 10–15 minuto, hanggang malambot ang mais at patatas.

Habang kumukulo ang sopas, hugasan ang bigas at ilagay kasama ang tubig nito sa maliit na kaserolang may takip. Pakuluan; takpan at lutuin sa mahinang apoy nang 10–12 minuto. Ipahinga nang may takip, walang apoy, nang 10 minuto. Sundin ang ratio sa pakete kung iba.

150 ml low-sodium halal chicken stock for sauce

recipes.title: Musakhan chicken bowl & tabbouleh
recipes.subtitle: Sumac chicken · lemon-tahini sauce · separate fresh tabbouleh
recipes.description: Sumac chicken · lemon-tahini sauce · separate fresh tabbouleh.

items: 170 g halal chicken breast, raw, bite-sized pieces
80 ml low-sodium halal chicken stock, or rice packet ratio
25 ml cold water, plus a splash to loosen
30 ml boiling water for bulgur, or packet ratio
40 g flat-leaf parsley leaves and tender stems, finely chopped

steps: Wash and dry herbs and vegetables. Finely chop tabbouleh ingredients; slice onion thinly. On a separate board, cut chicken into bite-sized pieces. Toss with the chicken oil and sumac, allspice, pepper and chicken salt.

Rinse rice. Add stock and rice salt; cover and simmer on low 10–12 minutes. Rest covered 10 minutes off heat. Cover fine bulgur with boiling water for 15 minutes, or follow packet directions. Drain any excess; cool.

Heat a wide pan over medium-high. Sear chicken 6–8 minutes, turning, until golden and 74°C inside. Transfer to a clean plate. Lower heat. Add the onion oil, onion and onion salt; soften 8–10 minutes. Add a splash of water if catching. Stir in onion sumac and chicken; warm through.
Whisk tahini, garlic, sauce lemon juice, sauce salt and cold water until pourable. Toss cooled bulgur with parsley, mint, tomato and cucumber. Add tabbouleh lemon juice, tabbouleh oil and its salt.
Spoon rice into a bowl. Add chicken and onions; drizzle with tahini sauce. Serve parsley-forward tabbouleh in a separate small bowl.

15 g lemon juice para sa tabbouleh

steps: Hugasan at patuyuin ang herbs at gulay. Pinong tadtarin ang sangkap ng tabbouleh; hiwain nang manipis ang sibuyas. Sa hiwalay na sangkalan, hiwain ang manok sa maliliit na piraso. Ihalo ang mantika at sumac para sa manok, allspice, paminta at asin para sa manok.

Hugasan ang bigas. Idagdag ang stock at asin para sa kanin; takpan at lutuin sa mahinang apoy nang 10–12 minuto. Ipahinga nang may takip nang 10 minuto. Ibabad ang pinong bulgur sa kumukulong tubig nang 15 minuto, o sundin ang pakete. Salain ang sobrang tubig; palamigin.

Painitin ang malapad na kawali sa katamtaman hanggang malakas na apoy. I-sear ang manok nang 6–8 minuto, binabaligtad, hanggang golden at 74°C sa loob. Ilipat sa malinis na plato. Hinaan ang apoy. Idagdag ang mantika para sa sibuyas, sibuyas at asin nito; palambutin nang 8–10 minuto. Dagdagan ng kaunting tubig kung dumidikit. Idagdag ang sumac para sa sibuyas at manok; painitin nang mabuti.

Haluin ang tahini, bawang, lemon juice at asin para sa sarsa at malamig na tubig hanggang madaling ibuhos. Ihalo ang malamig na bulgur sa parsley, mint, kamatis at pipino. Idagdag ang lemon juice para sa tabbouleh, mantika para sa tabbouleh at asin nito.
Ilagay ang kanin sa mangkok. Idagdag ang manok at sibuyas; lagyan ng tahini sauce. Ihain ang tabbouleh na maraming parsley sa hiwalay na maliit na mangkok.

recipes.title: Chicken tortilla soup
recipes.subtitle: Tomato-chilli broth · black beans · avocado · crisp corn tortilla
recipes.description: Tomato-chilli broth · black beans · avocado · crisp corn tortilla.

items: 170 g halal chicken breast, raw, whole piece
70 g cooked black beans, drained and rinsed
25 g corn tortilla, cut into small triangles

steps: Heat oven to 200°C conventional / 180°C fan. Wash vegetables and herbs. Dice onion and tomato; mince garlic. Cut tortilla into small triangles. Keep raw chicken separate.
Toss tortilla pieces with tortilla oil and tortilla salt; spread on a tray. Bake 7–10 minutes, turning once, until crisp and golden. Watch closely near the end.
Heat soup oil in a saucepan. Soften onion 5 minutes. Add garlic, cumin, paprika, chilli and oregano; stir 30 seconds. Add tomato and soup salt; cook 5 minutes until jammy. Pour in stock.

Add chicken; keep at a gentle simmer, partly covered, 12–18 minutes until the centre reaches 74°C. Lift chicken onto a clean board; shred with two forks. Return with beans and corn; simmer 3 minutes. Add a splash of water if needed to keep the soup brothy.
Turn off heat; stir in lime juice and coriander. Ladle into a bowl. Add diced avocado; serve crisp tortilla pieces alongside to add as you eat.

Ihalo ang mga piraso ng tortilla sa mantika para sa tortilla at asin nito; ikalat sa tray. I-bake nang 7–10 minuto, baligtarin minsan, hanggang malutong at golden. Bantayan sa huling minuto.

Painitin ang mantika para sa sopas sa kaserola. Palambutin ang sibuyas nang 5 minuto. Idagdag ang bawang, cumin, paprika, chilli at oregano; haluin nang 30 segundo. Idagdag ang kamatis at asin para sa sopas; lutuin nang 5 minuto hanggang lumapot. Ibuhos ang stock.

Idagdag ang manok; pakuluin nang marahan, bahagyang may takip, nang 12–18 minuto hanggang 74°C ang gitna. Ilipat ang manok sa malinis na sangkalan; himayin gamit ang dalawang tinidor. Ibalik kasama ang beans at mais; pakuluin nang marahan nang 3 minuto. Dagdagan ng kaunting tubig kung kailangan upang manatiling masabaw.
